pzi.AddResult {
    action: str | None
    bib_name: str | None
    bib_path: str | None
    changed_fields: list[str]
    citekey: str | None
    diff: NotRequired[str]
    dry_run: bool
    errors: list[str]
    message: str
    metadata_diagnostics: NotRequired[list[str]]
    pdf_error: NotRequired[str | None]
    pdf_path: str | None
    pdf_status: NotRequired[str | None]
    pdf_suggestion: NotRequired[str | None]
    pdf_url: NotRequired[str | None]
    reason: NotRequired[str]
    status: str
    warnings: list[str]
}
pzi.BibInfo {
    default: bool
    name: str
    papers_dir: str
    path: str
}
pzi.CheckResult {
    bib_name: str | None
    counts: dict[str, int]
    errors: list[str]
    items: list[CheckItem]
    reason: NotRequired[str]
    status: str
    strict: bool
    total: int
    warnings: list[str]
}
pzi.DedupeResult {
    bib_path: str
    errors: list[str]
    exact_duplicates: list[dict[str, Any]]
    fuzzy_candidates: list[dict[str, Any]]
    status: str
    total_clusters: int
    total_entries: int
    warnings: NotRequired[list[str]]
}
pzi.DeleteEntryResult {
    backup_path: NotRequired[str]
    bib_path: str
    citekey: str
    dry_run: NotRequired[bool]
    errors: list[str]
    message: str
    pdf_path: NotRequired[str | None]
    reason: NotRequired[str]
    status: str
    title: NotRequired[str]
}
pzi.EntryRecord {
    abstract: str | None

    citekey: str

    isbn: str | None

    local_pdf_path: str | None
    note: str | None

    pages: str | None
    pdf_url: str | None
    publisher: str | None
    source_url: str | None
    tags: list[str]

    venue: str | None
    volume: str | None
    year: int | None
}

    authors: list[str]
    citekey: str

    entry_type: str
    has_pdf: bool
    title: str
    year: int | None
}
pzi.MergeResult {
    backup_path: NotRequired[str]
    carried_fields: NotRequired[list[str]]
    changed_fields: NotRequired[list[str]]
    citekey_a: str
    citekey_b: str
    dropped_citekey: NotRequired[str]
    dropped_fields: NotRequired[list[str]]
    dry_run: bool
    errors: list[str]
    merged_record: NotRequired[dict[str, Any]]
    merged_title: NotRequired[str]
    message: str
    orphaned_pdf: NotRequired[str]
    overwritten_fields: NotRequired[list[str]]
    reason: NotRequired[str]
    status: str
}
pzi.PromoteItem {
    action: str
    backup_path: NotRequired[str]
    changed_fields: list[str]
    diff: NotRequired[str]
    failed: NotRequired[bool]
    metadata_diagnostics: NotRequired[list[str]]
    metadata_warnings: NotRequired[list[str]]

    pdf_attached: bool | None
    preprint_citekey: str
    published_citekey: str | None
}
pzi.PromoteResult {
    bib_name: str | None
    dry_run: bool
    errors: list[str]
    items: list[PromoteItem]
    keep_preprint: bool
    reason: NotRequired[str]
    status: str
    summary: NotRequired[dict[str, Any]]
}
pzi.PziError(message: 'str', *, code: 'int' = 5, details: 'list[str] | None' = None, reason: 'str | None' = None) -> 'None'

    authors: list[str]
    citekey: str
    matched_fields: list[str]

    year: int | None
}

    bib_name: str | None
    changed: bool

    dry_run: bool

    reason: NotRequired[str]
    status: str

}
pzi.__version__: str
pzi.add(source: 'str', *, tags: 'list[str] | None' = None, dry_run: 'bool' = False, force_new: 'bool' = False, config_path: 'str | None' = None, library: 'str | None' = None) -> 'AddResult'
pzi.add_tags(citekey: 'str', tags: 'list[str]', *, dry_run: 'bool' = False, config_path: 'str | None' = None, library: 'str | None' = None) -> 'TagChangeResult'
pzi.check(*, strict: 'bool' = False, config_path: 'str | None' = None, library: 'str | None' = None) -> 'CheckResult'
pzi.dedupe(*, config_path: 'str | None' = None, library: 'str | None' = None) -> 'DedupeResult'
pzi.delete(citekey: 'str', *, dry_run: 'bool' = False, config_path: 'str | None' = None, library: 'str | None' = None) -> 'DeleteEntryResult'
pzi.entries(*, offset: 'int' = 0, limit: 'int' = 50, sort: 'str' = 'citekey', config_path: 'str | None' = None, library: 'str | None' = None) -> 'list[EntrySummary]'
pzi.export(fmt: 'str' = 'bibtex', *, config_path: 'str | None' = None, library: 'str | None' = None) -> 'str'
pzi.get(citekey: 'str', *, config_path: 'str | None' = None, library: 'str | None' = None) -> 'EntryRecord'
pzi.list_bibs(*, config_path: 'str | None' = None) -> 'list[BibInfo]'
pzi.merge(citekey_a: 'str', citekey_b: 'str', *, dry_run: 'bool' = True, config_path: 'str | None' = None, library: 'str | None' = None) -> 'MergeResult'
pzi.promote(*, replace: 'bool' = False, dry_run: 'bool' = True, config_path: 'str | None' = None, library: 'str | None' = None) -> 'PromoteResult'
pzi.remove_tags(citekey: 'str', tags: 'list[str]', *, dry_run: 'bool' = False, config_path: 'str | None' = None, library: 'str | None' = None) -> 'TagChangeResult'
pzi.search(query: 'str | None' = None, *, author: 'str | None' = None, year: 'int | None' = None, tag: 'str | None' = None, config_path: 'str | None' = None, library: 'str | None' = None) -> 'list[SearchMatch]'
